name: Grotesque Guardians
dataSource: Monster statistics: OSRS Wiki via bundled monsters.json. Strategies: attack styles that can damage the boss (generated by scripts/gen-bosses.mjs).
validationNotes: DPS against each phase is covered by the reference validation tests where the rules are modelled. The share of the kill spent on each phase is an assumption; compare the per-phase DPS figures. Dawn, Dusk have special damage rules that are not modelled, so DPS is an estimate. Strategies are the attack styles that can damage this boss, best-known first; they are not a strategy guide. Damage-taken weights for Survivability are derived from the attack styles listed for the boss, equally weighted.

requirements.text: Requires an active gargoyle slayer task
Access requirements are not checked by the plugin: see the wiki page

warnings: Dusk only takes melee damage; Dawn cannot be hit with melee except by halberds.
Phase weights are assumptions; compare the per-phase DPS figures rather than only the weighted total.

strategies.description: Dawn cannot be hit with melee (except halberds) and Dusk only takes melee damage. Switch items are carried in the inventory.
